item.title: Why is China resisting a nuclear treaty with the US and Russia?
item.description: Beijing has a smaller arsenal than Washington and Moscow and worries that a pact could limit its nuclear capabilities.

item.title: At least 11 killed in blaze on Thailand’s Phuket island
item.description: Authorities are investigating the cause of the fire, which also injured 16, but have ruled out arson.

item.title: Russia’s Andreeva defeats Ukraine’s Svitolina 7-5, 6-3 to win WTA Finals
item.description: Mirra Andreeva won the final in straight sets to end her first Grand Slam-winning year as world number two.

item.title: The Red Sea cannot be secured without restoring the Yemeni state
item.description: Deployment of naval forces to the region cannot restore maritime security. Reinstating the Yemeni government can.

item.title: How Russia is preparing Iran for the next escalation
item.description: Russian space intelligence sharing can help Tehran get ready for an imminent US assault.

item.title: US and rivals spar over next UN boss as race lurches towards deadline
item.description: Costa Rica's Rebeca Grynspan is the current frontrunner, polls suggest, but the US and Russia could veto her bid.

item.title: Widow of Haiti’s slain leader Moise to contest presidential vote
item.description: Martine Moise is one of ​33 registered candidates running in Haiti's first presidential election in a decade.

item.title: Iraqi armed group denies involvement in oil smuggling, calls probe a ‘lie’
item.description: Iran-aligned Kataib Hezbollah says the group is subjected to 'blackmail' to force disarmament amid US pressure on Iraq.

item.title: Megaspeed, firm at centre of Nvidia scandal, says Alice Huang left in 2025
item.description: Chinese tech executive romantically linked to ex-Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang left in August 2025, Singapore-based firm says.

item.title: Indonesian president apologises to Singapore, Malaysia for wildfire haze
item.description: Prabowo says his government has a 'zero-tolerance policy' for firms that contribute to blazes and pledges strict action.

item.title: Pope Leo flies to mass in the Papacoptero
item.description: Pope Leo was filmed flying in the cockpit of an army helicopter to celebrate mass

item.title: Shophouse fire kills at least 11 in Phuket
item.description: Fire engulfed buildings in Thailand’s popular tourist town of Patong, killing several people and injuring many others.

item.title: ASEAN, China fall short of agreeing on South China Sea code
item.description: Southeast Asian leaders also denounce violence in Myanmar and extend ban on country's leader attending bloc's summits.

item.title: Houthis advance in Yemen as government forces move to defend Aden
item.description: An advance by the Houthi armed group in Yemen is threatening one of the government’s last strongholds.

item.title: Pope condemns murders of Peru’s Indigenous leaders, deforestation of Amazon
item.description: Pontiff says he supports Indigenous efforts to protect their lands, demands justice for slain environmental defenders.

item.title: Pope urges end to Amazon deforestation
item.description: Pope Leo XIV warns deforestation and illegal mining are threatening the Amazon rainforest and the local communities.

item.title: Founder of Guadalajara cartel dies in hospital after decades in prison
item.description: Miguel Angel Felix Gallardo was convicted of the 1985 murder of a US drug enforcement agent and a Mexican pilot.

item.title: After a nationwide ground stop, US faces aviation infrastructure questions
item.description: Trump has requested $50bn for upgrades, but Democratic lawmakers are asking for transparency before spending more.

item.title: Czechs rally against gov’t threat to media independence
item.description: Czechs rallied in Prague over plans to shift public media funding to the state, raising fears of government influence.

item.title: Zambia’s copper boom attracts billions in investment, but who benefits?
item.description: Workers' rights, environmental concerns and local businesses remain at the centre of the debate.

item.title: Eisenkot says Netanyahu can’t remain Israel PM amid alleged vote meddling
item.description: Arab party members were reportedly arrested before Israeli elections based on unfounded evidence from the PM's office.

item.title: Iran war live: Third US carrier arrives, Iran says oil tankers hit mines
item.description: The USS Theodore Roosevelt arrives in the Middle East, while IRGC says mines struck tankers in Strait of Hormuz.

item.title: Brawl erupts in Brazil’s Women’s League final
item.description: A fist fight erupted between opposing players during the final of Brazil's under-20 Women’s League.

item.title: England stun Spain to end La Roja’s 43-game unbeaten run
item.description: Spain suffer first defeat since March 2024 after losing 3-2 to England in Madrid despite grandstand finish.

item.title: Australia, Canada, Italy and the UK urge Israel to allow aid into Gaza
item.description: The countries accuse Israel of preventing tents and other supplies from entering Gaza, despite the humanitarian crisis.
